description: The same engine hydrating from a `string`-annotated cell — the §51.0.E-sanctioned persisted-status shape. Isolates the type mismatch from the hydration form.
rationale: §51.0.E — an `initial=@cell` source must carry either a `for=` enum value or a `string` holding a variant NAME (the canonical persisted-status case). A cell of any other concrete type cannot name a variant, so the engine could not resolve a starting state from it. An UNTYPED cell passes conservatively — the check fires only on a concrete, clearly-incompatible annotation.
